units: mm, g; geometry z up, flight report z down

sources.design: Astra organic forked deep-truss revision 1; engineering choices, not measurements

arm_r.comment: Rounded diagonal radius; 110 mm side spacing is authoritative, discrepancy 0.018 mm accommodated.

motor_safe_depth.comment: Measure safe thread depth before energizing. M2x10 has nominal 3 mm engagement; do not use longer unverified screws.

prop_plane_above_bell.comment: Legacy prop center 24.1; verify hub seating with actual motor/prop.

prop_envelope_t.comment: Rotating blade thickness/axial sweep unknown; check full swept envelope physically.

guard_pad_d.comment: Preserves >=1.6 mm ligament outside the two locating holes.

guard_od.comment: v2: ring ID 88 kept (5.9 mm prop-tip gap / crush margin; requirement >= 82.2) with the 2.4 mm wall. Astra 01 used 99 (ID 95, 9.4 mm gap); the guards were 43-50% of aircraft inertia.

guard_wall.comment: v2 rev B: 2.4 mm = 6 extrusion lines at 0.4 mm (was 2.0). Printed PETG guards broke at their joints, not the band, but the band folded easily under a thumb.

guard_top_z.comment: v2: 8 mm band centred on the prop plane (24.1). The stock 30 mm guard height included landing legs; Astra 01 kept ~10 mm of band above the prop.

guard_ring_bottom_z.comment: v2: 3 mm below the assumed prop envelope bottom (23.1).

guard_spoke_d.comment: v2 rev B: minimum spoke dimension (keel spoke width), used by the wall check.

guard_spoke_w.comment: v2 rev B: keel spoke width (round top radius 1.6).

guard_spoke_h.comment: v2 rev B: keel spoke total height: round top, vertical sides, V keel underneath.

guard_spoke_angles_deg.comment: v2 rev B: five independent spokes replace three Y-forks (the printed guards broke at the forks). The end spokes sit 5 deg inside the C ends, so the ring has no long free ends.

guard_keel_deg.comment: v2 rev B: keel faces 50 deg from horizontal: self-supporting when printed pad-down at any spoke slope.

guard_rib_t.comment: v2 rev B: radial thickness of the rib each spoke forms up the outside of the band (full band height).

guard_lip.comment: v2 rev B: outward lip on the band's top edge for hoop stiffness; outside the ring, so the prop-tip gap is unchanged.

guard_collar_h.comment: v2 rev B: collar on the motor side of the guard pad, outside the bell keep-out, deepening the spoke roots. Pad stays 2 mm so motor screw engagement is unchanged.

key_offset.comment: Two pins on opposite pad tangents, outside motor bell; avoids all motor slots.

arm_lower_sag.comment: v2: 0 = lower chords flat on the bed. Astra 01 sagged 4-6 mm below the pads, leaving the motor-screw seats printed on supports.

body_bolt_d.comment: M2.5 through bolts; check print tolerance.

fc_hole_d.comment: Pattern known; isolator stud diameter to verify.

fc_size.range: up to 37 x 37 x 15 through deck
fc_size.comment: Legacy 36 x 36 board envelope, 8 mm component height.

usb_size.comment: Side +y cable/tool corridor, verify actual connector side.

strap_w.comment: Actual Velcro unknown; slots sized from width plus 1 mm.

strap_t.comment: Actual compressed strap unknown; 0.6 mm clearance added.

flow_size.comment: Tape nest envelope; verify complete MTF-02P, connector and lens offsets.

flow_hole_spacing.comment: No guessed holes: foam-tape nest plus retention strap slots.

flow_recess.comment: v2: underside locating recess depth; leaves 1.7 mm of plate (>= min_wall).

flow_lens_d.comment: Cone starts at lower face of assumed optical envelope.

elrs_size.comment: Unknown receiver; open pocket, zip ties, rear antenna notch.

camera_size.comment: Combined XIAO, headers/heatsink envelope; local x depth, y width, z height.

camera_mount.comment: v2: 'under_nose' = cheeks rise from the bottom plate's front corners and the camera hangs below the frame, so nothing of the drone is in view at 30-75 deg. 'top' = Astra 01's frame cheeks from the deck corners; then use camera_pivot (38,0,41), where the front guards and props block ~18% of the image at 45 deg.

camera_pivot.comment: v2 under-nose: cradle sweeps x 34-66, z -32 to 0: 2.8 mm ahead of the battery stops, below the frame underside, ~14 mm above the ground. (Top mount: (38,0,41); Astra 01's (34,0,42) collides once the tilt points down.)

camera_hfov.comment: v2: from the firmware calibration main/at_detect.c (QVGA 320x240, F_X 163.50, C_X 154.01): edges 43.3/45.4 deg -> conservative symmetric 2 x 45.4 = 90.8 deg.

camera_vfov.comment: v2: from main/at_detect.c (F_Y 153.22, C_Y 107.10): edges 34.9/41.0 deg -> conservative symmetric 2 x 41.0 = 82 deg.

camera_lens_x.comment: Local lens protrusion ahead of board envelope.

camera_hood_margin.comment: v2: TPU hood lip ahead of the lens tip; hood edges sit 64-83 deg off-axis, outside the field of view.

petg_density.comment: g/cm3; use spool density and weigh print.

tpu_density.comment: g/cm3; use spool density and weigh print.

prop_mass.comment: Each, legacy estimate; inertia approximated by disc.

battery_mass.comment: Listing approx +/-5 g, not individually weighed.

misc_mass.comment: Fasteners, standoffs, isolators, wiring, strap, adhesives combined; modeled CG (0,0,0).
